import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    static BufferedReader br;
    static StringTokenizer st;
    static PrintWriter pw;

    static String nextToken() {
        try {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
        return st.nextToken();
    }

    static int nextInt() {
        return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
    }

    static long nextLong() {
        return Long.parseLong(nextToken());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int r = nextInt();
        int c = nextInt();
        String s = nextToken();
        int n = 2 * (r + c);
        long[] lsc = new long[n + 1];
        lsc[2 * r - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * r; i < n; i++) {
            lsc[i] = lsc[i - 1] * i / (i - 1 - 2 * r);
        }
        long[] rsc = new long[n + 1];
        long[] rsc2 = new long[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            rsc[i] = comb(i, r);
            rsc2[i] = comb(i, r - 1);
        }
        long nsum = rsc[n / 2] * rsc[n / 2];
        long msum = 0;
        int cnta = 0;
        int cntb = 0;
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (msum > 0) {
                int ok = 1;
            } else {
                int ok = 0;
            }
            if (cntb == n / 2) {
                int ok = 1;
            }
            if (cnta == n / 2) {
                int ok = 0;
            }
            if (ok) {
                cnta++;
                msum = msum - rsc2[n / 2 - cnta] * rsc[n / 2 - cntb];
            } else {
                cntb++;
                msum = msum + rsc2[n / 2 - cntb] * rsc[n / 2 - cnta];
            }
        }
        msum = Math.max(msum, -msum);
        Map<Pair, Long> mm = new HashMap<>();
        mm.put(new Pair(0, 0), 1L);
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 2 * r - 1; i--) {
            Map<Pair, Long> nm = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : mm.entrySet()) {
                long sum = it.getKey().x;
                int ncnt = (int) it.getValue();
                int cnt = it.getKey().y;
                int ast = n / 2 - cnt;
                int bst = i + 1 - ast;
                long asum = sum + rsc2[ast - 1] * rsc[bst];
                long bsum = sum - rsc2[bst - 1] * rsc[ast];
                if (s.charAt(i) == 'A') {
                    nm.put(new Pair(asum, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(asum, cnt + 1), 0L) + ncnt);
                    nm.put(new Pair(bsum, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bsum, cnt), 0L) + 0L);
                } else if (s.charAt(i) == 'B') {
                    nm.put(new Pair(asum, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(asum, cnt + 1), 0L) + 0L);
                    nm.put(new Pair(bsum, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bsum, cnt), 0L) + ncnt);
                } else {
                    nm.put(new Pair(asum, cnt + 1), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(asum, cnt + 1), 0L) + ncnt);
                    nm.put(new Pair(bsum, cnt), nm.getOrDefault(new Pair(bsum, cnt), 0L) + ncnt);
                }
            }
            nsum = nsum - lsc[i];
            mm.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : nm.entrySet()) {
                long sum = it.getKey().x;
                int ncnt = (int) it.getValue();
                int cnt = it.getKey().y;
                int ast = n / 2 - cnt;
                int bst = i - ast;
                if (cnt > n / 2 || n - i - cnt > n / 2) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (sum < -msum - rsc[ast] * rsc[bst] || sum > msum + rsc[ast] * rsc[bst]) {
                    continue;
                }
                mm.put(new Pair(sum, cnt), mm.getOrDefault(new Pair(sum, cnt), 0L) + ncnt);
            }
        }
        long bsum = 1e18;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> it : mm.entrySet()) {
            long sum = it.getKey().x;
            int ncnt = (int) it.getValue();
            int cnt = it.getKey().y;
            if (sum == bsum || sum == -bsum) {
                int sem = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 2 * r - 1; j++) {
                    if (s.charAt(j) == '?') {
                        sem++;
                    } else if (s.charAt(j) == 'A') {
                        cnt++;
                    }
                }
                long ncnt2 = ncnt * comb(sem, n / 2 - cnt);
                long rasp = rasp + ncnt2;
            }
        }
        pw.println(rasp);
        pw.close();
    }

    static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k || k < 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        long rez = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            rez = rez * (n - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return rez;
    }

    static class Pair {
        long x;
        int y;

        public Pair(long x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return x == pair.x && y == pair.y;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return (int) (x ^ (x >>> 32)) * 31 + y;
        }
    }
